title: Credibility assessment of CFD models for a vibrating mesh nebuliser’s droplet size distribution under ASME V&V40
runhead: CFD credibility for mesh-nebuliser droplet size
device: Vibrating mesh nebuliser for inhalation therapy

models.name: M1: Pore-resolved VOF CFD (micro-scale)
models.what_it_computes: Transient two-phase flow through an oscillating perforated mesh patch; primary ligament formation and pinch-off; near-field droplet size distribution within 0.5 mm downstream of the mesh (D10, D32, Dv50).

models.name: M2: Device-scale LES–PBE two-phase CFD
models.what_it_computes: Eulerian–Lagrangian LES of the headspace and mouthpiece with a population balance for breakup/coalescence; delivered droplet size distribution at the mouthpiece exit (MMAD, GSD, Dv10/Dv50/Dv90).

mechanisms.name: Mechanism A: Primary atomization at vibrating pore rims
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Sets the seed droplet size distribution that controls downstream aerosol evolution and ultimately lung deposition.

mechanisms.name: Mechanism B: Secondary breakup and coalescence in post-mesh shear and baffle interaction
mechanisms.why_it_matters: Refines or broadens the size spectrum before patient delivery, affecting dose uniformity and regional deposition.

deviation.detail: All factor-level results are reported on a 0–8 Credibility Attainment Index (0 none, 8 extensive), applied per model × mechanism pair.

context_of_use.statement: Use M1 and M2 to inform selection among candidate mesh geometries and operating waveforms that are likely to meet a predefined droplet size distribution target (e.g., MMAD 2–5 μm with GSD ≤ 2.0) prior to confirmatory benchtop testing. The models are used to down-select designs and operating points for a single nebuliser platform with aqueous formulations of known viscosity and surface tension.
context_of_use.rationale: Within design verification, the models guide internal go/no-go decisions for design variants and test matrices, replacing exploratory bench iterations but not final verification or release testing.

model_risk.rationale: Decision consequence is moderate because droplet size distribution influences lung deposition and dose consistency; however, final product verification includes mandatory bench measurements before patient use. Model influence is moderate because model outputs guide down-selection but do not provide the sole basis for release. The combination yields a medium model risk level.

scoring_scale: 0–8 Credibility Attainment Index per factor and per model × mechanism pair (0 none, 1 minimal, 2 limited, 3 emerging, 4 partial, 5 moderate, 6 substantial, 7 strong, 8 extensive).
